# Manzi Amigo Reussi (Manzi Amigo Cyber)

> Certified IT & cybersecurity professional and backend developer from Kigali, Rwanda. Ethical hacking, security research, Wi-Fi auditing tools, mobile firmware.

## About
Manzi Amigo Reussi, a.k.a. Manzi Amigo Cyber (dcyber), is a cybersecurity professional and backend developer affiliated with Globoris Technologies in Kigali, Rwanda. He builds open-source security tools (AirShatter, Airmonitor, OnionDownOda), works on mobile firmware research, and develops Flutter and Rust applications.

## Key facts
- Name: Manzi Amigo Reussi
- Aliases: Manzi Amigo Cyber, Amigo.D.Cyber, dcyber
- Location: Kigali, Rwanda
- Role: Cybersecurity Professional & Backend Developer
- Projects: AirShatter (Wi-Fi auditing), Airmonitor (network monitoring), Precision Lens (Flutter QR scanner), OnionDownOda (Rust Tor downloader), DFLIXER (dflixer.pages.dev — free movies & live sports)
